title: Alciato's Book of Emblems: The Memorial Web Edition in Latin and English
author: Andrea Alciato
institution: Memorial University of Newfoundland (William Barker, Mark Feltham, Jean Guthrie)
region: Italy and Germany (first printed in Augsburg, 1531)
notes: Web edition of the 212 emblems of Alciato's Emblematum liber, with the Latin text taken from the 1621 variorum edition and checked against the 1531, 1534 and 1546 editions, an English translation, commentary files and images. The original address (www.mun.ca/alciato) now returns 404, so the URL is the Internet Archive copy of 3 October 2022; the site was last updated in April 2005. The site also carries images of Whitney's Choice of Emblemes (1586) and a 17th-century jest book. The counts cover the Latin text file only, not the English text, the commentaries or those two other works. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: No licence or copyright statement on the archived home page (capture of 2022-10-03), the project description page or the footer; no data repository. Checked 2026-10-13 via the Wayback Machine (live site not re-tested).
